name: Doki Doki Weatheard World
source:
After spending a couple days in Monika's void, she decides she was wrong about the world. Conjuring up the remaining files, she pieces together the world so that the two of you may have your happy ending. However! The world is still rundown and broken. Will you end up fixing the world and having your happy ending? Or will you meet your own Weatheard World?
[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/8dxzzw/doki_doki_weatheard_world_full_release_download/]DDLC Mods[/url]]
